title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-020. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, proves that a cubical four-component Dirac Hamiltonian squares to its continuum symbol, controls lattice and centered-time corrections, and derives the positive-frequency density/current limit from the same action and embeddings. It proves scoped copy exchange and a conditional cubical spin-one-half representation. Within a stated real, local, first-order, flavor-preserving cubical-incidence class, DIRAC-018 classifies the continuum square root independently on both exact rank-four copies and proves the C19 scalar-symbol zero census. DIRAC-019 proves all-update density/current transport for finite positive-frequency spectral families. DIRAC-020 constructs an explicit normalized finite Fourier frame, proves periodic cubic character-to-momentum compatibility, and proves coherent spatial Parseval density, integrated current transport, and a finite-update pointwise phase-error bound. The result does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots, construct exact native finite-spacing Dirac packet evolution, prove a uniform fixed-physical-time error rate, settle all fermion doubling, or prove a localized physical electron or electromagnetic coupling.
